examples.arabic: انا اديته كورة وهو كان مبسوط قوي بالهديه
examples.english: I gave him a ball and he was very happy with the gift
examples.transliteration: ana edetou kora we howa kan mabsout awy bel hadeya

examples.arabic: في الاخر اداني هديه لمعي مع الجلابيه
examples.english: At the end he gave me a shiny gift with the galabeya.
examples.transliteration: fi el aakhir iddaani hidiyya lamei maa el galabiyya

examples.english: Mona wants to open this gift
examples.transliteration: Mona ayza tefta7 el hedeyya di

examples.english: She wanted a gift for her mother.

examples.arabic: ماما وبابا اشتروا هدية حلوة لبنت عمي في ديسمبر
examples.english: Mom and Dad bought a nice gift for my cousin in December.
examples.transliteration: Mama w baba eshtaraw hedeya helwa le bent ammi fi december

examples.arabic: أزيك يا عمو، أنا عايزة هدية. سألت بتردد.
examples.english: How are you, uncle? I want a gift. She asked hesitantly.
examples.transliteration: Azzayik ya 3ammo, ana 3ayza hedeyya. Sa'alet bi-taraddud.
